title: Automatic panel benders
subtitle: Senfeng BDC push-down panel benders 59 – 126″ · suction-cup panel benders 47 – 59″ · 0.2 s per bend · robot cells
cover_line: Senfeng Laser · made in China · sold & serviced in Canada by NovoTech
about_title: Four-side bending with no tooling changes
about_text: A panel bender clamps the blank once and forms every side — up, down, hems, box corners — in 0.2 s per bend while a manipulator turns the part: boxes, doors, enclosures, cabinets and HVAC panels in sheet to 14 ga, five to ten times faster than a press brake and without a skilled operator. The push-down BDC series bends 59 to 126″ with 13 to 16 servo axes, a 7.9″ bending height (11.8″ optional) and automatic thickness compensation; the suction-cup BDC1200 and 1500 are the light machines for door and appliance panels to 20 ga. Robot loading and unloading cells are available.

Senfeng Laser has built fiber laser machines in Jinan, Shandong, since 2004: a 1.8 million ft² campus, its own laser sources, cutting heads and welding guns, around 15,000 machines a year, 20 overseas branches and Senfeng Laser USA with a warehouse and service team. CE, FDA and ETL certified. NovoTech sells, installs and supports the machines in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario — layout for your building, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
